title: Polite Questions: Addressing Someone as Ön

sections.content: Ön is the formal word for 'you'. Verbs used with Ön take the ordinary third-person singular form -- the same ending as 'he/she' -- there is no separate polite verb ending to learn.

items.english: Good day! What are you looking for?

sections.content: Ön is usually dropped, just like other subject pronouns -- the third-person verb form alone signals politeness once the context (a shop assistant addressing a customer) makes it clear.
